blind.description: No text or labels are visible on the model or renders. The model is a decorative architectural pedestal or pillar consisting of a stepped square base with bevelled moulding, a central cylindrical shaft decorated with spiraling carved foliage/vines, an ornate foliate capital with flared corner acanthus leaves, and a flat square tabletop with an embossed floral emblem. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and continuous with no broken shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or floating flakes. Nothing is hovering unattached, and no geometry is melted or fused. It stands on its own integrated square base whose underside sits completely flat on the floor, with no added external slab, disc, or plinth. The material appears as weathered moss-green stone or patinated verdigris bronze with olive-green body, yellow-green edge highlights, and dark crevices. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and no flame or glow effects.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as an axis-aligned square top plate with four flared, pointed corner tips (the tops of the capital leaves). In the center of the square surface is an embossed four-petaled / eight-lobed floral rosette motif framed by a raised square border in olive-green tones.
blind.height_vs_figure: The model is approximately 13 to 14 ft tall (about 2.3 to 2.4 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, which reaches roughly mid-shaft). Its square top is about 5.2 ft wide (nearly as wide as the figure is tall), the base is about 4 ft wide, and the central shaft is about 1.5 ft in diameter (similar to the figure width).
